sources.entry: django-ai-plugins - Django backend agent skills for Django, DRF, Celery, and Django-specific code review.

summary.one_liner: A set of portable Django backend skills (Agent Skills format) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other tools that support the Agent Skills specification.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds one canonical authoring tree of Agent Skills under skills/, with host manifests and package-local copies generated from plugins/catalog.json. It ships five capabilities: django-expert (Django backend, ORM, DRF, security, testing, performance), django-celery-expert (Celery task design, retries, scheduling, operations), cdrf-expert (DRF class selection, lifecycle tracing, MRO, safe overrides), django-safe-migration (PostgreSQL-aware, zero-downtime migration guidance), and django-reviewer (report-first Django and Python review of recent or selected changes). It includes generation, validation, and isolated smoke-test scripts for each target host. The README says the skills can complement the django-ai-boost MCP server but do not require it.
use_cases: Give a coding agent Django and DRF expertise
Design reliable Celery tasks with retries and scheduling
Trace DRF view lifecycle and choose generic class-based views
Review recent Django or Python changes with a report
Install Django skills into Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor
notable: Single canonical skills tree generates host-specific marketplaces and plugin packages for Claude, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode
Five distinct skills covering Django core, Celery, DRF internals, safe migrations, and code review
Smoke runner installs into a temporary location so host setups are not modified
Migration guidance is PostgreSQL-aware and focused on zero-downtime changes
caveats: Compatibility validation level differs per host adapter; the README points to a matrix for details
Package manifests and package-local skills are generated outputs and should not be edited by hand
Contributors are directed to AGENTS.md before changing catalog or skill content
keywords: share django expertise with my agent
